notes: The initial audit reported parser-or-schema because .json occurred in successful HTTP request paths. A deterministic audit-tool regression fixes that false positive; final audit includes the exact source-position expectation.
A media/caption sample failure is retained even when discovery selected the correct episode. No host is declared universally available.
No title-specific ID, fixed season length or episode offset is present in production mapping code. Reference IDs/positions belong only to development fixtures and the maintenance inventory.
Valid primary metadata still needs one request; explicit IMDb-based seasonal recovery needs one additional metadata request. Other discovery counts vary with hosts and redirects.
This release changes only the dedicated Anime-Sama plugin and development tools/docs. Sources FR generated providers and shared resolvers remain unchanged.
